text:
opsbot: INCIDENT: Pager triggered for hosted-api-prod (us-east-1) — latency p95 ~3500ms, error rate ~5%, approx 12 customers affected. Paging elena (primary) and sam (secondary). Incident created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-8721

elena (oncall-primary): I'm oncall, looking now. grabbing logs and deploy history.

sam (oncall-secondary): I'm online, will shadow and take any routing/fallback work. ping me if you need me to flip traffic.

opsbot: Recent deploys: model-serving v2.14 -> rolled 22m ago to pool-east-1. No autoscaler events in last 30m. Latest metric snapshot: p50 110ms, p95 3500ms, errors 4.9%.

mike: Confirming scope — EU regions show normal p95 ~210ms. Looks constrained to us-east-1 inference pool.

elena (oncall-primary): OK. quick plan: 1) check KV cache size / hot-key eviction 2) attempt targeted eviction on hot prefixes 3) if no improvement in 3m, restart model-serving pool for the affected model shard 4) enable fallback routing to smaller model variant as last-resort.

devon: I have the kv-cache runbook handy: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-thrashing and the short play: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall/kv-evict. I can run eviction now.

elena (oncall-primary): please run eviction and paste the command you used here. I'll watch metrics.

devon: running now. command I used:```bash
# check hot keys (safe read)
curl -sS "https://metrics.internal/api/kv/hotkeys?pool=pool-east-1&top=20" | jq .

# targeted evict (runbook-approved)
redwoodctl kv evict --pool pool-east-1 --prefix "session:" --confirm
```

opsbot: Action logged: kv-evict started by devon at 4760001305. Watchers: elena, sam.

elena (oncall-primary): seeing initial response — p95 dropped to ~900ms, errors down to 0.8%. still above baseline but big improvement. good sign.

sam (oncall-secondary): nice. monitor for 5m to ensure no rebound. if it rebounds, we escalate to pool restart.

elena (oncall-primary): agree. continuing 5m watch window. devon, can you collect a short trace for the top 3 callers so we can postmortem? add traces to INC-8721.

devon: yup, collecting now. command:```bash
redwoodctl traces collect --incident INC-8721 --top 3 --out /tmp/INC-8721-traces.json
```

opsbot: Note: autoscaler has a cooldown; manual pool restart permitted per runbook if recovery stalls. Restart runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall/pool-restart (follow canary steps).

mike: If we do restart, suggest restarting the smallest subgroup first to avoid full outage. follow runbook canary.

elena (oncall-primary): if metrics hold for 10m we'll keep config. Sam — I'm assigning primary until 03:00 UTC, you'll remain secondary. If anything degrades, call my name and escalate to SRE pager.

sam (oncall-secondary): got it. I'll watch and stand ready to flip fallback route if needed.

devon: created followup artifact and attached traces to INC-8721. Also created a short checklist for post-incident items: postmortem owner, timeline, mitigation steps taken.

elena (oncall-primary): Postmortem owner: devon. I'll do the customer-impact blurb for support channels (which customers, ETA, actions taken). devon, please include the k-v hotkey list and eviction commands in the doc.

sre-bot: Reminder: add the tag "prod-latency" and set priority=high on INC-8721. Retention for logs set to 90 days for this incident.

elena (oncall-primary): Final status for this thread: mitigation by targeted kv-evict succeeded; p95 now ~300-950ms depending on spike windows, errors <1%. No pool restart required. We will keep monitoring for 60m, then normal handoff at 03:00 UTC.

sam (oncall-secondary): I will escalate if errors creep back over 2%.

devon: I'll draft the postmortem and link the runbooks used: kv-cache-thrashing, kv-evict, pool-restart, route-fallback. Links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache-thrashing , https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall/kv-evict , https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall/pool-restart , https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall/route-fallback

elena (oncall-primary): thanks team. short notes for handover: primary=elena until 03:00UTC, secondary=sam, followup ticket INC-8721-POST with owner devon, customer comms draft in INC-8721. If anything new appears after handoff, page the SRE rotation and tag me in the followup. :thumbsup:

opsbot: Incident INC-8721 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Logged actions: kv-evict, traces collected, followup ticket created.

elena (oncall-primary): closing thread for immediate actions. leaving notes in the incident doc.
